description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. A heavy brown wooden war hammer striking diagonally into a small cracked blue steel shield. Big pale impact cracks and two blue fragments show armor penetration. Hammer head at upper left, shield at lower right. Bold simple silhouette, no arrows, no text.
